digest.component_or_area: review-bot event store and tickets repository clone management
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot tickets clone that predate the A6-0b deployment and are not tracked in the repository
The first file (TICKET_DIGEST.json) is a superseded unsigned derived cache with a newer committed digest available, making it disposable residue
The second file (CLAIM_ENRICH.json) is an expired queue claim with a later committed claim and completion status, making it obsolete queue residue
Both files were verified to be disposable (non-unique) and authorized for deletion only if repository state and file hashes exactly match recorded preconditions
After conditional deletion of both files, the persistent clone was verified to have no untracked event files and HEAD equalling refs/remotes/origin/tickets with no merge or rebase state
